results.notes: Two sub-probes: (1) status=REJECTED returns upstream 400 with enum error confirming allowed values exactly match TRUTH.yaml {PENDING,APPROVED,WITHDRAWN_APPROVAL}. (2) status=APPROVED returns live data confirming bare-array shape, approvalRequest wrapper structure, ISO 8601 duration strings, and money in minor units. One minor imprecision found: TRUTH.yaml documents billableAmount as integer but live raw shows floating-point (e.g. 885877.777...). Not a demotion — type:number for costAmount is correct in TRUTH.

Omitting required start_date triggers MCP schema error -32602 before any upstream call. Confirms start_date is required as TRUTH.yaml documents. Minor gap: user_group_ids is accepted by MCP tool but not in TRUTH.yaml requestBody schema — low severity.
Page 999 returns {invoices:[], total:0} confirming TRUTH.yaml's wrapper shape on an empty page. No bare-array anomaly. total=0 is accurate (workspace has no invoices currently).

Page 999 returns empty results confirming bare-array wire format (MCP wraps for tooling). total=49900 is MCP total_min heuristic artifact (page*page_size), not a TRUTH.yaml error. page_size respected as documented.
Page 999 returns empty results confirming bare-array wire format. Same total_min quirk as projects. 4-field item shape could not be re-asserted on empty page but original happy-path evidence stands.

findings_for_truth_yaml.finding: TRUTH.yaml documents billableAmount as type:integer but live raw shows it is floating-point (e.g. 885877.7777777782). Should be type:number. costAmount is already correctly typed as number.
TRUTH.yaml requestBody schema is missing user_group_ids optional field. The MCP tool accepts it and the Clockify UI supports group-based holiday assignments.
